summary: A junior aide picks up a pencil when two senior colleagues leave the next step unsettled.
realLife: Murphy recalled beginning an outline on a yellow pad after a convention speech meeting ended without a clear assignment and his senior colleagues hesitated to lead.
inGame: needs: unassigned writing task and deadline.

turns.pulledBy: The colleagues accept the outline as a starting point.
turns.what: The aide reads it back for their changes.
turns.writesBack: The group has a draft to work on.

turns.what: The aide hands over the notes already made.
turns.writesBack: The assignment now has a named writer.
